description: This Dart source file implements a Flutter widget for a Doctor Profile Screen, allowing viewing and editing of a doctor's profile, fetching data from an API and managing local state.

classes.name: DoctorProfileScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays and allows editing of a doctor's profile.

classes.name: _DoctorProfileScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the profile data, UI state, and API interactions for the DoctorProfileScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loads profile data upon widget creation.

methods.description: Fetches the list of doctors from the API and sets the current doctor based on user ID.

methods.description: Sends updated specialty and bio data to the API to update the doctor's profile.
